verdict.rationale: LibreChat ships its own Agent Management API, labelled beta. It supports creating, discovering, updating and deleting agents, managing agent files and Skills, and authenticating machine clients via OIDC. A probe also found a published OpenAPI spec, which suggests the API is publicly documented. However, the API is beta, and the evidence only shows agent management, not driving conversations or the rest of the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a stable (non-beta) API, evidence that the API covers chat and other core product actions, in-depth endpoint documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Agent Management API (beta): Create, discover, update, and delete Agents; manage Agent files and Skills; and authenticate machine clients through deployment-bound OIDC identities
